result.summary: 18 new tests: LinkExpiryUpdateTest (13: FR1-FR7, NFR2-01), the PATCH case added to ManagementTokenRateLimitTest, and four expiry races added to ClickDeletionRaceTest; no existing test changed or removed.

decisions.choice: ManagementTokenRateLimitTest and ClickDeletionRaceTest only gain new test methods, helpers and imports; every existing method is byte-identical
decisions.rationale: The approved impact plan requires both extensions; keeping existing methods untouched preserves their protection

decisions.topic: TC-NFR2-02 and TC-NFR3-01 not implemented as Java tests
decisions.choice: The README/API docs are written by the parallel docs stage and the changelog and release record by the later release stage, so neither exists when this suite runs; they are enforced by the docs_cover_api, release_checklist_passed and files_exist gates instead
decisions.rationale: A Java test for an artifact produced after the test stage would fail by construction

decisions.topic: TC-NFR1-01 and TC-NFR1-02 covered by the existing suite
decisions.choice: The test gate runs every existing test, including RedirectLatencyTest, with a floor of 121 tests
decisions.rationale: Compatibility is the existing tests still passing unchanged

decisions.choice: Removing the expired check, reading a missing field as null, bypassing the throttle on PATCH, and dropping the row lock each make a new test fail
decisions.rationale: A green suite is evidence only if it can fail
